decisive_items: high-grade ostial stenosis of the left renal, celiac trunk, and superior mesenteric arteries
Right kidney atrophy without discernible right renal artery
response.rationale: R3 uniquely links difficult-to-treat hypertension to bilateral renal artery compromise, including left ostial stenosis and right kidney atrophy, with an epigastric bruit. R2 captures stenosis and dyslipidemia but omits the hypertensive syndrome. R1 is weakened by near-normal creatinine and no albuminuria. R4 rests only on hypertension and is contradicted by normal potassium and no family history.

rejected.why: Near-normal creatinine and unremarkable urinalysis without albuminuria do not support CKD; right kidney atrophy is better explained by renal artery occlusion.
Only difficult-to-treat hypertension is offered; normal potassium and no relevant family history contradict Liddle syndrome.
